name: get-posts-by-algolia
description: Cloud Function responsável pelas buscas de posts pelo algolia

scripts.deploy-cloud-function: cd deploy && gcloud functions deploy searchPostsByAlgolia --gen2 --runtime nodejs22 --trigger-http --region southamerica-east1 --allow-unauthenticated --project ${GCP_PROJECT:-corresocialapp} --entry-point searchPostsByAlgolia --service-account fn-search@${GCP_PROJECT:-corresocialapp}.iam.gserviceaccount.com --set-secrets ALGOLIA_ID=ALGOLIA_ID:latest,ALGOLIA_KEY=ALGOLIA_KEY:latest --clear-env-vars

author: Wellington Souza
